aiDiagnosis.summary: নতুন জন্ম নিবন্ধনের জন্য আবেদন করতে আপনি সঠিক স্থানে আছেন। জন্ম নিবন্ধন প্রতিটি নাগরিকের জন্য একটি অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ সরকারি সনদ।
requiredDocuments: হাসপাতালের জন্ম সনদের মূল কপি (যদি থাকে)
পিতা-মাতার এনআইডি (NID) কার্ডের কপি
টিন সার্টিফিকেট বা বাড়িভাড়ার রসিদ / ইউটিলিটি বিলের কপি (ঠিকানা প্রমাণের জন্য)
steps: অনলাইন জন্ম নিবন্ধন পোর্টালে (bdris.gov.bd) প্রবেশ করুন এবং আবেদন ফরম পূরণ করুন।
পূরণকৃত ফরমটি প্রিন্ট করে প্রয়োজনীয় কাগজপত্রসহ আপনার স্থানীয় ইউনিয়ন পরিষদ বা পৌরসভা অফিসে জমা দিন।
নির্ধারিত ফি পরিশোধ করুন এবং নির্দিষ্ট তারিখ অনুযায়ী আপনার জন্ম সনদ সংগ্রহ করুন।

aiDiagnosis.summary: Since you are 18 years or above and have an online Birth Registration Certificate, you are fully eligible to apply for a new National Identity (NID) card as a new voter through the Election Commission of Bangladesh online portal.
requiredDocuments: Online Birth Registration Certificate (English version preferred)
Educational certificates (SSC or equivalent, if applicable/available)
Utility bill copy (Electricity, Gas, or Water) as proof of address
Parent's NID card copies
Passport size photograph
steps: Visit the official Election Commission Bangladesh NID portal (services.nidw.gov.bd).
Click on 'Apply Online' (নতুন ভোটার নিবন্ধন) and create an account using your online Birth Registration details.
Fill out the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and address information.
Upload scanned copies of required documents (Birth Certificate, Utility Bill, etc.).
Submit the application online and print the application copy along with the slip for biometric appointment.
Visit your local Upazila/Thana Election Office on the scheduled date for biometric data collection (fingerprints, photograph, and iris scan).

requestText: I want to register a new trade license for my business. What is the procedure?

aiDiagnosis.summary: As Sahajjo AI, I am here to help you register a new trade license for your business in Bangladesh. A trade license is mandatory for legally operating any business within a city corporation, municipality, or union parishad jurisdiction.
requiredDocuments: National ID (NID) card of the business owner
Passport-sized photographs of the applicant
Proof of business address (Rent agreement or property ownership deed)
Holding tax receipt of the business premises
TIN certificate (if applicable)
steps: Visit the local government authority office (City Corporation/Municipality/Union Parishad) or their online service portal.
Fill out the Trade License application form (K-Form) and submit it along with all required documents.
Pay the prescribed license and signboard fees to receive your official Trade License certificate.

followUpQuestions.question: What is the location type of your business establishment?
What is the nature of your business?

aiDiagnosis.summary: Process for correcting father's name on an existing birth registration certificate for an adult (above 5 years).
requiredDocuments: Existing digital birth registration certificate
Father's correct birth registration certificate or National ID (NID) card
Educational certificates (SSC certificate, marksheet, etc.) if applicable
Parental documents showing the correct name (marriage certificate, passport, etc.)
Application form signed by the applicant
steps: Visit the official Birth and Death Registration website (bdris.gov.bd).
Navigate to the 'Birth Registration Information Correction' section.
Enter your existing birth registration number and date of birth.
Select 'Father's Name' as the field to be corrected and provide the correct spelling/details.
Upload scanned copies of supporting documents verifying the correct name of the father.
Submit the application online and print the application receipt.
Submit the printed copy along with original supporting documents to your local Union Parishad, Paurashava, or Ward Councilor office for verification and final approval.

steps: Visit the official Election Commission NID portal (services.nidw.gov.bd).

Select the 'Information Correction' (তথ্য সংশোধন) option.
Choose the specific fields you want to correct and provide the correct information.
Upload scanned copies of all required supporting documents.
Pay the applicable government fees online via mobile banking or debit/credit card.
Submit the application and download the application copy for future reference.
